Name,
Supply chain and material procurement continue to be a major challenge on construction projects. We believe that using software to manage materials in a central location is a benefit to collaboration and success of our projects.
Please take a look at DigiBuild software suite.
Their DigiProcure material procurement and tracking tool. Find, order, track, manage materials, may provide better pricing, more visibility into lead times, and reduced schedule delays. It also simplifies bidding and captures procurement data.
Take a look at the link to a quick video and the 1 pager under folder 02.Subcontractor Resources.  We'd appreciate it if you would schedule a demo with them. They're working with some of our trade partners providing major benefits and we believe this can provide direct value to our projects together and on any of your other projects.
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1JMJW2woto62VtvIcQRkavsd4lnkEDxee/view?usp=sharing

Name,
Supply chain and material procurement continue to be a major challenge on construction projects. We believe that using software to manage materials in a central location is a benefit to collaboration and success of our projects.
Please take a look at DigiBuild software suite.
Their DigiProcure material procurement and tracking tool. Find, order, track, manage materials, may provide better pricing, more visibility into lead times, and reduced schedule delays. It also simplifies bidding and captures procurement data.
Take a look at the link to a quick video and the 1 pager under folder 02.Subcontractor Resources.  We'd appreciate it if you would schedule a demo with them. They're working with some of our trade partners providing major benefits and we believe this can provide direct value to our projects together and on any of your other projects.
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1JMJW2woto62VtvIcQRkavsd4lnkEDxee/view?usp=sharing
